issues.detail: In message M41, speaker_id is formatted as a string ("136230") instead of an integer.
Thread TH2 contains only 12 messages, which violates the global minimum of 15 messages per thread and is significantly below its target range of 20-30.
Blueprint requires artifact T2 to be referenced in thread TH4, but it is missing from all artifact_refs in that thread.
Participants exhibit very similar, highly professional and structured communication styles with little variation in tone or vocabulary.
